records.name: General Fernlage
records.biography_en: Fernlage watches the HyperNorm courtyard through an instrument he rarely raises. A card proposing that rank cannot settle distance receives his heaviest lower lip: the situation is either under command or improperly situated. Men in Black demand a clear overview. He polishes the spyglass while waiting for events to arrange themselves into something he can approve.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Überblick wird erwartet. Das Fernrohr ist bereits vorhanden.

variant_notes.note_en: He expects the distant situation to improve out of respect for his rank.

records.name: Feldwebelin Säbelmut
records.biography_en: Säbelmut treats every HyperNorm corridor as the beginning of a splendid manoeuvre. A card allowing hesitation to count as courage makes her grin widen: movement is either forward or an explanation. Hunky & Dory reward her initiative with another assignment. She keeps the saber close enough to her own body that the plan still has room to change.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Aufbruch war überzeugend. Die Richtung wird nachgetragen.

variant_notes.note_en: She has mistaken the thrill of beginning for a reliable plan.

records.name: Gefreiter Zündverzug
records.biography_en: Zündverzug hugs his old musket beside the HyperNorm stairwell and listens for permission to relax. A card suggesting that readiness can include doubt leaves him staring at the lock: equipment is either safe or about to become his responsibility. Men in Black call this vigilance. He suspects that a canteen ought to make the job feel less dry.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Bereitschaft hält. Der Beteiligte bittet um Abstand.

variant_notes.note_en: He checks his equipment with the worried tenderness usually reserved for relatives.

records.name: Hauptmann Kugelpflicht
records.biography_en: Kugelpflicht carries a cannonball through HyperNorm meetings as if it were the only item whose weight had been honestly declared. A card proposing that responsibility can be shared earns a tired sideways grimace. Hunky & Dory praise his dependability. He keeps the rammer handy, although the corridor has never supplied anything that it can usefully clear.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Verantwortung wurde gewogen. Sie bleibt bei ihm.

variant_notes.note_en: He carries every small responsibility as if it were ammunition.

records.name: Leutnantin Vorratsrecht
records.biography_en: Vorratsrecht keeps her HyperNorm ration tin firmly shut and the key conspicuously available. A card suggesting that a reserve becomes useful when opened is filed as premature consumption: provisions are either accounted for or lost. Men in Black appreciate her control. She occasionally listens to the box, hoping that its contents have learned to justify themselves.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Bestand ist gesichert. Über seine Verwendung liegen keine Angaben vor.

variant_notes.note_en: She considers a closed box the most persuasive kind of inventory.

records.name: Korporal Taktbruch
records.biography_en: Taktbruch announces every HyperNorm assembly with a beat so enthusiastic that a meeting becomes difficult to cancel. A card allowing people to gather without agreeing receives a second flourish: attendance is either in time or obstructive. Hunky & Dory encourage morale. He looks upward between strokes, delighted by the possibility that somebody is finally about to join him.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Stimmung wurde eröffnet. Die Tagesordnung versucht aufzuschließen.

variant_notes.note_en: He supplies the collective enthusiasm before anybody has requested it.
